gazette_location.description_raw_en: Road commencing at its junction with WO YI HOP ROAD and running in a south-westerly direction for about 1 120 metres where it terminates at its junction with TSUEN KAM INTERCHANGE as shown coloured pink and hatched black on Drawing No. NTA/TW/R90F.
gazette_location.description_raw_zh: 此路由與和宜合道交界處起，向西南伸展約一千一百二十米，至與荃錦交匯處交界止。在NTA/TW/R90F號圖則上以粉紅色間以黑斜線標明。

gazette_location.description_raw_en: Lane commencing at its junction with SAI LAU KOK ROAD and running in a north-easterly direction for about 20 metres where it terminates as shown coloured pink and hatched black on Drawing No. NTA/TW/R90F.
gazette_location.description_raw_zh: 此里由與西樓角路交界處起，向東北伸展約二十米止。在NTA/TW/R90F號圖則上以粉紅色間以黑斜線標明。

gazette_location.description_raw_en: Street commencing at its junction with SHING MUN ROAD and running in a north-westerly direction for about 95 metres to terminate at its junction with WAI TSUEN ROAD as shown coloured pink and hatched black on Drawing No. NTA/TW/R90F.
gazette_location.description_raw_zh: 此街由與城門道交界處起，向西北伸展約九十五米，至與蕙荃路交界處止。在NTA/TW/R90F號圖則上以粉紅色間以黑斜線標明。

gazette_location.description_raw_en: Road commencing at its junction with CHEUNG PEI SHAN ROAD and running in a generally southerly direction for about 60 metres where it curves to run in a south-westerly direction for about 270 metres; it then branches to two sub-sections with one sub-section running south south-westerly for about 95 metres, whilst the other sub-section running in a south-westerly direction for about 95 metres where it runs through a subway for about 30 metres and then curves to run in a south south-easterly direction for about 80 metres respectively, and both sub-sections terminate at their junctions with an unnamed road as shown coloured pink and hatched black on Drawing No. NTA/TW/R90F.
gazette_location.description_raw_zh: 此路由與象鼻山路交界處起，向南伸展約六十米，再向西南伸展約二百七十米，然後分為兩分段，一分段向西南偏南伸展約九十五米，另一分段則向西南伸展約九十五米，再伸展約三十米經過一隧道，再向東南偏南伸展約八十米。兩分段均分別至與一未命名之道路交界處止。在NTA/TW/R90F號圖則上以粉紅色間以黑斜線標明。

gazette_location.description_raw_en: Thoroughfare commencing from the viaduct at its junction with CASTLE PEAK ROAD TSUEN WAN and running in a south-westerly direction for about 50 metres where it bends to run in a north-easterly direction for about 65 metres; it then branches to two sub-sections with one sub-section running in a northerly direction for about 50 metres, whilst the other sub-section running in a north-easterly direction for about 80 metres respectively, and both sub-sections terminate at their junctions with an unnamed road and CASTLE PEAK ROAD KWAI CHUNG respectively as shown coloured pink and hatched black on Drawing No. NTA/TW/R90F.
gazette_location.description_raw_zh: 此道路由與青山公路荃灣段交界處之高架道路起，向西南伸展約五十米，再向東北伸展約六十五米，然後分為兩分段，一分段向北伸展約五十米，另一分段則向東北伸展約八十米，兩分段均分別至與一未命名道路及青山公路葵涌段交界處止。在NTA/TW/R90F號圖則上以粉紅色間以黑斜線標明。

gazette_location.description_raw_en: Thoroughfare commencing at its junction with an unnamed road and running in a south-westerly direction for about 120 metres, it then bends to run in a generally northerly direction for about 130 metres before it curves to run easterly for about 95 metres where it stretches to run north-easterly for about 175 metres to meet CHEUNG PEI SHAN ROAD; it continues to run in a generally south-easterly direction for about 90 metres and stretches to run east north-easterly for about 165 metres to meet CHEUNG PEI SHAN ROAD again before it terminates as shown coloured pink and hatched black on Drawing No. NTA/TW/R90F.
gazette_location.description_raw_zh: 此道路由與一未命名道路交界處起，向西南伸展約一百二十米，然後向北伸展約一百三十米，再向東伸展約九十五米，又再向東北伸展約一百七十五米，至與象鼻山路；其後繼續向東南伸展約九十米，後向東北偏東伸展約一百六十五米，再至與象鼻山路止。在NTA/TW/R90F號圖則上以粉紅色間以黑斜線標明。

gazette_location.description_raw_en: Road commencing at its junction with SAI LAU KOK ROAD and running in a north-easterly direction for about 300 metres before it bends to run in a north-westerly direction for about 220 metres where it terminates at its junction with TSUEN KAM INTERCHANGE as shown coloured pink and hatched black on Drawing No. NTA/TW/R90F.
gazette_location.description_raw_zh: 此路由與西樓角路交界處起，向東北伸展約三百米，然後向西北伸展約二百二十米，至與荃錦交匯處止。在NTA/TW/R90F號圖則上以粉紅色間以黑斜線標明。

gazette_location.description_raw_en: Lane commencing at its junction with WANG LUNG STREET and running in a west south-westerly direction for about 65 metres before it bends sharply to run in a south-easterly direction for about 160 metres where it terminates at its junction with LUNG TAK STREET as shown coloured pink and hatched black on Drawing No. NTA/TW/R100A.
gazette_location.description_raw_zh: 此里由與橫龍街交界處起，向西南偏西伸展約六十五米，然後急轉向東南伸展約一百六十米，至與龍德街交界處止。在NTA/TW/R100A號圖則上以粉紅色間以黑斜線標明。
